an4.202:1.1: vo bhikkhave desessāmi asappurisena asappurisatarañ ca
an4.202:1.2: sappurisañ ca sappurisena sappurisatarañ ca, taṃ suṇātha . . . pe . . . 2.
an4.202:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco asaddho hoti ahiriko hoti anottāpī hoti appassuto hoti kusīto hoti muṭṭhassati hoti duppañño hoti.
an4.202:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca asaddho hoti parañ ca asaddhāya samādapeti,
an4.202:3.3: attanā ca ahiriko hoti parañ ca ahirikāya samādapeti,
an4.202:3.4: attanā ca anottāpī hoti parañ ca anottāpitāya samādapeti,
an4.202:3.5: attanā ca appassuto hoti parañ ca appassute samādapeti,
an4.202:3.6: attanā ca kusīto hoti parañ ca kosajje samādapeti,
an4.202:3.7: attanā ca muṭṭhassati hoti parañ ca muṭṭhasacce samādapeti,
an4.202:3.8: attanā duppañño hoti parañ ca duppaññatāya samādapeti.
an4.202:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco saddho hoti hirimā hoti ottāpī hoti bahussuto hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti satimā hoti paññavā hoti.
an4.202:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti parañ ca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti,
an4.202:5.3: attanā ca hirimā hoti parañ ca hirimante samādapeti
an4.202:5.4: attanā ca ottāpī hoti parañ ca ottāpe samādapeti,
an4.202:5.5: attanā ca bahussuto hoti parañ ca bāhusacce samādapeti,
an4.202:5.6: attanā ca āraddhaviriyo hoti parañ ca viriyāmbhe samādapeti,
an4.202:5.7: attanā ca upaṭṭhitasati hoti parañ ca satipaṭṭhāne samādapeti,
an4.202:5.8: attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti parañ ca paññāsampadāya samādapeti.
an4.202:5.9: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sappurisena sappurisataro ti. 203. 1.
